note: Questions asked by a shared application rather than by one college. Every prompt here was read from two independent sources that agreed word for word, and the source_url is the one a counselor should open to check it.

apps.name: Common App
apps.prompts_note: Choose one and write between 250 and 650 words. The prompts were unchanged for 2026-27.

prompts.title: Background, identity, interest or talent
prompts.prompt: Some students have a background, identity, interest, or talent that is so meaningful they believe their application would be incomplete without it. If this sounds like you, then please share your story.

prompts.title: A challenge, setback or failure
prompts.prompt: The lessons we take from obstacles we encounter can be fundamental to later success. Recount a time when you faced a challenge, setback, or failure. How did it affect you, and what did you learn from the experience?

prompts.title: Questioning a belief or idea
prompts.prompt: Reflect on a time when you questioned or challenged a belief or idea. What prompted your thinking? What was the outcome?

prompts.title: Gratitude
prompts.prompt: Reflect on something that someone has done for you that has made you happy or thankful in a surprising way. How has this gratitude affected or motivated you?

prompts.title: Personal growth
prompts.prompt: Discuss an accomplishment, event, or realization that sparked a period of personal growth and a new understanding of yourself or others.

prompts.title: A topic that captivates you
prompts.prompt: Describe a topic, idea, or concept you find so engaging that it makes you lose all track of time. Why does it captivate you? What or who do you turn to when you want to learn more?

prompts.title: Topic of your choice
prompts.prompt: Share an essay on any topic of your choice. It can be one you've already written, one that responds to a different prompt, or one of your own design.

apps.name: UC Personal Insight
apps.prompts_note: Answer four of the eight. Every University of California campus reads the same four, and there is no separate personal statement.

prompts.title: Leadership
prompts.prompt: Describe an example of your leadership experience in which you have positively influenced others, helped resolve disputes or contributed to group efforts over time.

prompts.title: Creative side
prompts.prompt: Every person has a creative side, and it can be expressed in many ways: problem solving, original and innovative thinking, and artistically, to name a few. Describe how you express your creative side.

prompts.title: Greatest talent or skill
prompts.prompt: What would you say is your greatest talent or skill? How have you developed and demonstrated that talent over time?

prompts.title: Educational opportunity or barrier
prompts.prompt: Describe how you have taken advantage of a significant educational opportunity or worked to overcome an educational barrier you have faced.

prompts.title: Most significant challenge
prompts.prompt: Describe the most significant challenge you have faced and the steps you have taken to overcome this challenge. How has this challenge affected your academic achievement?

prompts.title: An academic subject that inspires you
prompts.prompt: Think about an academic subject that inspires you. Describe how you have furthered this interest inside and/or outside of the classroom.

prompts.title: Making your community better
prompts.prompt: What have you done to make your school or your community a better place?

prompts.title: What makes you a strong candidate
prompts.prompt: Beyond what has already been shared in your application, what do you believe makes you a strong candidate for admissions to the University of California?

apps.name: Coalition App
apps.prompts_note: Choose one and write 500 to 650 words. The Coalition Application runs on Scoir.

prompts.title: A story from your life
prompts.prompt: Tell a story from your life, describing an experience that either demonstrates your character or helped to shape it.

prompts.title: What interests or excites you
prompts.prompt: What interests or excites you? How does it shape who you are now or who you might become in the future?

prompts.title: A positive impact on others
prompts.prompt: Describe a time when you had a positive impact on others. What were the challenges? What were the rewards?

prompts.title: An idea of yours questioned
prompts.prompt: Has there been a time when an idea or belief of yours was questioned? How did you respond? What did you learn?

prompts.title: Successes and obstacles
prompts.prompt: What successes have you achieved and what obstacles have you faced? What advice would you give a sibling or friend going through a similar experience?

prompts.title: Topic of your choice
prompts.prompt: Submit an essay on a topic of your choice.

apps.name: Activities and Honors
apps.prompts_note: Not essays, but the Common App's tightest writing and the part students leave to the last night. Ten activities and five honors, each with its own hard character limit.

prompts.title: Activity description
prompts.prompt: Describe this activity, including what you accomplished and any recognition you received. You have ten activity slots and 150 characters for each description, which is about twenty-five words.

prompts.title: Position or leadership title
prompts.prompt: Your position, leadership role or job title for this activity. Optional, and capped at 50 characters.

prompts.title: Organisation name
prompts.prompt: The organisation, club, employer or programme this activity belongs to, in 100 characters.

prompts.title: Academic honor
prompts.prompt: An academic honor earned in grades 9 through 12, in 100 characters. Five slots. Merit-based awards belong here; clubs, jobs and leadership belong in Activities and Experiences.
